info.title: ForgeTrust.AppSurface.Cli
info.description: Command-line tooling for AppSurface named-canary deployment proof, PostgreSQL Durable schema migrations, documentation, coverage, PWA verification, and declared secret-promotion workflows.

commands.name: poll
commands.description: Poll a protected named canary until it passes or reaches a terminal result.

options.name: --url
options.description: application base URL, for example https://app.example.com.

options.name: --name
options.description: registered lowercase named-canary identifier.

options.name: --marker-env
options.description: Optional environment variable containing the canary marker. Never pass a marker directly on the command line.

options.name: --fresh-since
options.description: Optional RFC 3339 proof freshness boundary, for example 2026-07-30T00:00:00Z.

options.name: --bearer-token-env
options.description: Optional environment variable containing a bearer token.

options.name: --identity-token-env
options.description: Optional environment variable containing an already acquired identity token.

options.name: --header-env
options.description: Optional repeatable custom header source in HEADER=VARIABLE form. Values are read only from environment variables.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Total polling deadline. Supports a positive number followed by ms, s, m, or h. The timeout/interval pair supports at most 300 attempts. Default: 5m. Default: <5m>.

options.name: --interval
options.description: Polling interval. Supports a positive number followed by ms, s, m, or h. The timeout/interval pair supports at most 300 attempts. Default: 5s. Default: <5s>.

options.name: --max-transient-failures
options.description: Maximum consecutive recoverable transport failures. Default: 3. Default: <3>.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write one machine-readable JSON terminal result to stdout. Default: <false>.

options.name: --github-summary
options.description: Write a GitHub Actions step summary when GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY is available. Default: <false>.

options.name: --no-github-summary
options.description: Suppress GitHub Actions step summary output. Default: <false>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Inspect AppSurface coverage commands for local coverage execution and threshold enforcement.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: gate
commands.description: Enforce line and branch thresholds from a Cobertura coverage file.

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Cobertura XML path. Defaults to TestResults/coverage-merged/coverage.cobertura.xml. Default: <TestResults/coverage-merged/coverage.cobertura.xml>.

options.name: --min-line
options.description: Minimum line coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Default: <0>.

options.name: --min-branch
options.description: Minimum branch coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Default: <0>.

options.name: --tolerance
options.description: Coverage tolerance percentage from 0 to 100. Defaults to 0.5. Default: <0.5>.

options.name: --diff-base
options.description: Git ref or commit used with HEAD to estimate changed-line coverage.

options.name: --diff-file
options.description: Unified diff file used to estimate changed-line coverage without local git history.

options.name: --diff-stdin
options.description: Read unified diff text from stdin to estimate changed-line coverage. Default: <false>.

options.name: --diff-label
options.description: Display label for the selected patch diff source in reports.

options.name: --repository-root
options.description: Repository root used for Cobertura and diff path matching. Defaults to the git worktree root when available.

options.name: --min-patch-line
options.description: Minimum changed-line coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Requires one patch source: --diff-base, --diff-file, or --diff-stdin.

options.name: --patch-line-mode
options.description: Changed-line calculation mode: measurable or codecov. Defaults to measurable.

options.name: --min-patch-branch
options.description: Minimum changed-branch coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Requires one patch source: --diff-base, --diff-file, or --diff-stdin.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for coverage-gate reports and active patch target artifacts.

options.name: --github-summary
options.description: Append the Markdown report to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when it is set. Default: <true>.

options.name: --no-github-summary
options.description: Do not append to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY even when it is set. Default: <false>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge existing Cobertura shards into local AppSurface coverage artifacts.

options.name: --source
options.description: directory containing coverage.cobertura.xml shard files to merge.

options.name: --output
options.description: Coverage output directory. Defaults to TestResults/coverage-merged. Default: <TestResults/coverage-merged>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run instrumented .NET tests and merge Cobertura coverage locally.

options.name: --solution
options.description: Solution file used for test project discovery. Supports .sln and .slnx.

options.name: --test-project
options.description: Repeatable explicit test project path. Skips solution discovery when supplied.

options.name: --exclude-test-project
options.description: Repeatable solution-relative test project glob to exclude from coverage execution.

options.name: --output
options.description: Coverage output directory. Defaults to TestResults/coverage-merged. Default: <TestResults/coverage-merged>.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build/test configuration. Defaults to Debug. Default: <Debug>.

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Positive integer for non-exclusive test project concurrency. Defaults to 1. Default: <1>.

options.name: --schedule
options.description: Project scheduling mode: input-order or longest-first. Defaults to input-order. Default: <input-order>.

options.name: --schedule-timings
options.description: timings.json file used by --schedule longest-first instead of the output directory's previous timings.

options.name: --priority-test-project
options.description: Repeatable non-exclusive project path or file name to run first when --schedule longest-first is used.

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Pass --no-restore to build and test commands. Default: <false>.

options.name: --build
options.description: Build the solution once before tests, including explicit-project runs. Default: <false>.

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Skip the solution build before tests. Default: <false>.

options.name: --include
options.description: Coverlet include filter. Omit for Coverlet's project defaults.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Coverlet exclude filter. Defaults to [*.Tests]*,[*.IntegrationTests]*.

options.name: --coverage-driver
options.description: Coverage driver: collector or msbuild. Defaults to collector. Default: <collector>.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print discovery, scheduling, and artifact paths without running tests. Default: <false>.

options.name: --list-projects
options.description: List selected and skipped projects without running tests. Default: <false>.

options.name: --no-discover-exclusive
options.description: Do not auto-classify integration or Playwright projects as exclusive. Default: <false>.

options.name: --exclusive-test-project
options.description: Repeatable project path or file name that should run exclusively.

options.name: --logger
options.description: Repeatable dotnet test logger value, such as junit;LogFilePath=... .

options.name: --test-argument
options.description: Repeatable extra argument token appended to every dotnet test invocation.

options.name: --test-results
options.description: Managed test result format. Only junit is supported in this release.

options.name: --slow-test-diagnostics
options.description: Write slow-test diagnostics from managed JUnit test results. Default: <false>.

options.name: --no-clean
options.description: Do not clean existing AppSurface-owned output before the run. Default: <false>.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: dotnet test verbosity. Defaults to minimal. Default: <minimal>.

options.name: --heartbeat-interval
options.description: Heartbeat interval using 500ms, 30s, 10m, or 1h syntax. Defaults to 30s; 0 disables heartbeats. Default: <30s>.

options.name: --no-progress-timeout
options.description: Positive no-observable-progress timeout. Defaults to 10m. Default: <10m>.

options.name: --watchdog
options.description: Stall handling mode: warn, fail, or off. Defaults to warn. Default: <warn>.

options.name: --require-non-sandbox
options.description: Fail before discovery, output cleanup, build, or tests when a known sandbox environment marker is present. Default: <false>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.
